name: manual_76d313
claim: A handoff doc's own status (BLOCKED, needs review) does not mean the underlying problem is still unresolved -- the same problem can get fixed a different way by a different agent/session before the handoff is ever picked up. Before acting on a handoff's recommended fix, re-check the actual current state of what it describes (PR status, CI status, file content) rather than trusting the handoff's problem statement at face value.

decisions.notes: 2026-07-22: a scratch handoff doc for the PR190 CI-fix thread described PR190 as BLOCKED with a circular-dependency problem needing orchestrator resolution -- but PR190 had already merged successfully 3 days prior with the CI check passing, meaning the blocking problem no longer existed by the time the handoff was read. The handoff correctly diagnosed the root cause and even named the right fix (Option B), but its BLOCKED status was stale.
